structural_history_boundaries.barrier_reason: Inception date of XLC (Communication Services Select Sector SPDR). Before this date, XLC did not exist.

structural_history_boundaries.leveraged_reason: Inception date of ProShares Ultra QQQ (QLD) and ProShares Ultra S&P500 (SSO).
structural_history_boundaries.recommended_full_universe_window: 2018-07-02 to 2026-07-06 (8.0 calendar years of continuous 24-symbol coverage)

market_calendar_and_session_alignment.missing_session_policy: Strict validation against exchange calendar. Gaps due to market holidays (e.g. Good Friday, Memorial Day) allowed; unscheduled session dropouts trigger alert.

adjustment_and_leakage_control.split_adjustment: Backward ratio adjustment applied to prices (open, high, low, close) and inverse to volume. Preserves percentage returns across splits without artificial gaps.
adjustment_and_leakage_control.dividend_policy: Raw unadjusted prices maintained alongside split-adjusted prices. To prevent lookahead leakage, cash dividends are credited to cash balance on ex-dividend date during backtest replay rather than retroactively adjusting historical price series.
adjustment_and_leakage_control.point_in_time_safety: Bars delivered to agent.decide() at date T close strictly contain historical observations through session T close. Execution fills at session T+1 open price + slippage.
